description: MarPowSim is the MATLAB and Simulink marine power-system library developed at NTNU through the D2V research project with maritime partners. It includes diesel generators, batteries, switchboards, breakers, electric thrusters and power-management components. Inputs are an assembled Simulink plant, component parameters and operating scenarios; outputs are the simulated vessel power-system and control responses. Spatial coverage follows the configured vessel; temporal resolution and simulation duration depend on its model. Source is free under GPL-3.0, with installation and example-building instructions. A limitation is the older documented environment, MATLAB R2013a with ACADO, a supported compiler and the MSS toolbox; compatibility with current versions was not tested here. The library can study hybrid vessel power, control and energy use in maritime infrastructure simulations. HAMS (model-hams) offers related marine hydrodynamics at a different physical layer. The README cites the 2015 Marine Vessel and Power Plant System Simulator paper. No models or installers were downloaded.
